column1: # @trace order:2068-eeti, order:2055-d9sa
# THE DEMUCS WEIGHT MANIFEST, read by crates/tillandsias-headless/src/audio_separate.rs.
# One row per FILE audio.separate needs, pinned by publisher revision, sha256 and size.
# NONE of these files is ever baked into an image or redistributed by Tillandsias:
# they are fetched on the user's own machine by the restricted fetch (order
# 2068-ypgq), after the project's licence acknowledgement and the user's yes,
# through the model-hubs tier, into the shared model cache at
#   <models_dir>/audio/demucs/<file>
# which the separator (order 2068-cqis) mounts read-only.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   model       the audio.separate model name: htdemucs | htdemucs_6s
#   repo        Hugging Face id (the maintainer's own repos)
#   revision    the Hub commit the file is pinned at
#   file        the file in that repo, and its path under audio/demucs/
#   sha256      the Hub's LFS sha256 (?blobs=true)
#   bytes       size
#   licence     licence id; demucs-weights-unstated is RESTRICTED (the restricted
#               register carries its terms, quoting the maintainer's README)
#   source      the model card
# SAFETENSORS ONLY (coordinator ruling 2026-11-10): these are the maintainer's
# own exports, class and init args as JSON in the safetensors metadata, read
# from the Hub API on 2026-11-10. Each corresponds to the upstream pickle
# (.th) the Demucs package downloads; that pickle is never fetched or loaded:
#   htdemucs     955717e8-8726e21a.th  ->  adefossez/HTDemucs 955717e8.safetensors
#   htdemucs_6s  5c90dfd2-34c22ccb.th  ->  adefossez/HTDemucs-6s 5c90dfd2.safetensors
htdemucs
htdemucs_6s
